Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection I1 for thyristor element which must be performed on yearly 
bases or during outage as indicated in the title block.
Technical Specifications:
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Eman El Henawey, tested by eng. Wagih Khalil, revised by MDEPC quality control 
eng. Adel El-Naggar, accepted by general manager eng. Ali Zahran and approved by 
eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd 
El Gillil MDEPC quality control general manager and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Nageb inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Brushes
Blower.
Screw driver.
Work to be 
carried out
Check the resistance between the gate and cathode (RGK) or between the anode 
 and cathode (RAK) and compare with criteria value
Retighten the gate socket
Clean around the thyristor tray
Exchange between the cooling fans
